data.exact_reserve_text: Favourable movements of GBP 13.7 million, (2014: GBP 8.6 million), in the past year's provision for claims outstanding, net of expected reinsurance recoveries, are included in claims incurred, net of reinsurance. These arose in respect of the following classes of business:
data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2015 gross claims outstanding were GBP 95.746m. During 2015 there was a net gross release of GBP 13.638m (approximately 14.2% of opening gross claims outstanding), driven by favourable claims development and expected reinsurance recoveries across several classes of business. The managing agent reports net favourable movements of GBP 13.7m (net of reinsurance) by class; the gross movement reconciling in the technical provisions note is a GBP 13.638m release.
raw_causal_phrases: Favourable movements of GBP 13.7 million, (2014: GBP 8.6 million), in the past year's provision for claims outstanding, net of expected reinsurance recoveries, are included in claims incurred, net of reinsurance.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Primary gross prior-year movement taken from Technical Provisions note 'Change in prior year provisions' (gross = -GBP 13,638k on page 40). The claims note text (page 33) reports a net favourable movement of GBP 13.7m (net of reinsurance) and provides a per-class breakdown; the per-class amounts in the claims note are net of reinsurance and were used to populate LOB movements (confidence lowered to 0.8 because these are net figures, not gross). Claims development triangle (gross) is present and transcribed from the 'Claims development' table (page 39). Minor rounding differences may exist between summed net class movements and gross movement due to the reinsurer's share.
